# The now line breaks at each row and misses the header's line by 1 px

Owned by Vega: the line came in with my #21315 (#20890), and the fix touches the grid body's row separator two days before the cut, so no contributor labels.

## Context

The operator, 20 Nov, from the frames of PR #21659 (a Gantt chart): "the red line gets cut by every row border. it does NOT match the position inside the column headers." Reproduced on `dev` (`2d028b974d`) in both families that draw the line, with `timeAxis.now` set inside the range at runtime, at 1440 × 900:

| Example | `now` | Header line x | Body line x | Body segments | Gap at each row border |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `examples/gantt/basic` | `2026-11-14T12:00Z` | 1171.39 | 1170.39 | 5, one per row | 1 px |
| `examples/scheduler/basic` | `2026-11-09T12:00Z` | 536 | 535 | 7, one per row | 1 px |

The header's line is the right one: `Sat 14` spans 1086 to 1258.8, so 12:00 is at 1172.4, the header line's centre. The body's line sits 1 px to its left. Between the header line's bottom (119) and the first body segment's top (121) there is a 2 px seam as well.

## The Problem

The line marks one instant, so it should read as one straight line from the header mark down to the last row. Instead it reads as stacked dashes, shifted against the header mark. These are two defects:

1. The body draws one segment per row, and every row border interrupts it.
2. The header's coordinate origin sits 1 px right of the body's. That moves every element the header positions (ticks, non-working bands, the now line) against its body counterpart.

#20890's unit spec pins the `left` values, which agree, so only rendered geometry shows either defect.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/timeline/Column.mjs:757-765` pushes one `.neo-timeline-now` into each row's track (`${trackId}__now`), positioned `absolute` with `top: 0; bottom: 0` (`resources/css/src/timeline/Column.css:37-47`).
- The row border is the timeline cell's own `border-bottom: 1px` (`.neo-grid-cell.neo-timeline-cell`). That cell clips (`overflow: hidden`, `contain: content`), so a segment can never cover it.
- A single body-level line cannot replace the segments. Each row is its own stacking context (`.neo-grid-row`: `transform`, `contain: strict`) with an opaque cell background: a line below the rows is hidden, and a line above them crosses bar titles. Inside each track the bars sit at `z-index: 1`, above the line's `0`.
- `src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs:775-780` draws the header's own line in the minor row at the same `nowOffset`. The header element (`.neo-timeline-header.neo-grid-header-button`) has `border-left: 1px`, so its rows start at x 222 while the body's track starts at 221.
- Design authority: #20890, point 4: "The timeline family marks the current time: a line through the body at `dateToOffset(now)` and a mark on that tick in the header, for the scheduler and the Gantt chart alike." Both sides take one value, `TimeAxis#getNowOffset` ("Returns the pixel offset of {@link #now}"), so one x is intended. The constraint to keep is in `Column.css`: "drawn beneath the bars so it never crosses a title".

## The Fix

1. **Rows:** draw the timeline cell's row separator inside its padding box, for example as an inset bottom shadow instead of `border-bottom`. Each row's segment then covers it, and the segments meet. Row heights and the locked columns' separators must line up as before.
2. **Header origin:** start the header's rows where the body's track starts. Either drop the timeline header button's left border and keep the separator on the locked side, or offset its rows by the border width. Ticks, non-working bands and the now line then share the body's x.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With `now` inside the range, the body's now line has no gap at any row border, in `examples/gantt/basic` and `examples/scheduler/basic`. *(Amended 20 Nov while building: the 2 px header/body seam stays. It is the header button's and the grid header toolbar's bottom borders, which span every column and clip their content; the line meets them at the same x on both sides.)*
- [ ] The body line's rendered x equals the header line's within 0.5 px, and both centre on `now` against its tick (12:00 falls on the tick's midpoint), in neo-light and neo-dark.
- [ ] A header tick's edge and a non-working band's edge line up with the body's within 0.5 px (the scheduler with `showNonWorkingTime`).
- [ ] The line stays beneath the bars: a bar crossing `now` keeps its title uncrossed.
- [ ] An e2e spec under `test/playwright/e2e/` pins the first two ACs from rendered rects.
- [ ] Look: before/after frames at the header/body seam and across three rows, in both neo themes, on the pull request.

## Out of Scope

- The line's behaviour when `now` is outside the range, and `now: null` reading the viewer's clock (#20890).
- The header's tick formats, and the design of non-working bands.
